Tabs

Tabs are used to organize content by grouping similar information on the same page.
ExamplesCodeUsage

Usage

Use tabs to break content into multiple sections that people can view without having to navigate away from that page.

Accessibility

  • Keyboard users can navigate between tabs using the left and right arrow keys. The tab key is used to navigate to the tab content, not to the next tab. This is so that people who use screen readers don't have to tab through all of the tabs to read the content.
  • Surface important information outside of tabs, and keep the number of tabs low.

Best practices

Use tabs when you have concise content.

Do

Use short labels.

Hierarchy

Don't nest tabs.

Behavior

Tab behavior during default, focus, hover, and active states.

  1. Default: The standard view.
  2. Focus: Keyboard focus on a tab.
  3. Hover: Hovering over a tab.
  4. Press: Pressing a tab.
  5. Selected: Indicates the tab that the user is viewing.
